notes: Flagged large unit reviewed and retained: לְ + מַעַל + directive he is rendered by the single adverb exceedingly, so the three share one unit headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme (rules 30, 32).
לְעֵינֵי here is split, not fused, because the ASV writes a word for each morpheme (in / the sight); the same phrase fuses to before at 1CH.29.10, where one word stands for the pair.

such is given to הוֹד as a supplied determiner under rule 15 while the written relative אֲשֶׁר takes as under rule 46's first rider; reading such … as as one correlative pair on the relative was the competing analysis.
